You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Willow fixtures","question":"Can the plant send bench W8 to assembly?","claims":{"A":"Bench W8 withstood a 600 N load in the batch acceptance test.","B":"Bench W8 came from production lot L9.","C":"Bench W8 had only three fittings torqued before acceptance."},"handoff":"The plant can confirm that bench W8 belongs to production lot L9, supported by the production traveller (S2). The claim that only three fittings were torqued before acceptance is contradicted by the torque record (S1), which shows four fittings torqued. The key question is whether bench W8 withstood a 600 N load; the photograph (S3) shows a  600 N setpoint but lacks the serial number and measured load, leaving this claim unresolved. Without conclusive evidence that bench W8 passed the load test, the decision to send it to assembly remains uncertain. Further verification of the load test specific to bench W8 is needed before proceeding.","follow_up":{"S4":"a separate quality rig record identifies W8 and records a completed, passing 600 N acceptance test."}}

Claim B is supported by the production traveller (S2) confirming W8's lot. Claim C is contradicted by the torque record (S1) showing four fittings torqued, not three. Thus, the plant can send bench W8 to assembly based on confirmed load test success."}

parsed.note: Claim A was initially unresolved due to lack of direct evidence linking bench W8 to the 600 N load test (S3 lacked serial number), but the follow-up record S4 conclusively identifies W8 and confirms a passing 600 N test, supporting the claim. Claim B is supported by the production traveller (S2) confirming W8's lot. Claim C is contradicted by the torque record (S1) showing four fittings torqued, not three. Thus, the plant can send bench W8 to assembly based on confirmed load test success.
